TABLE.NAME: tool_activitydates
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the activity dates scheduling configuration per course

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this configuration applies to

FIELD.NAME: modtype
FIELD.COMMENT: The module or activity type to schedule

FIELD.NAME: schedulestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when scheduling begins

FIELD.NAME: schedulefinish
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when scheduling ends

FIELD.NAME: sessionlength
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of days per session

FIELD.NAME: activitiespersession
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of activities to schedule per session

FIELD.NAME: hideunselected
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to hide unselected activities

FIELD.NAME: resetunselected
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to reset availability for unselected activities

FIELD.NAME: finishenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the schedule finish date caps the sessions scheduled

FIELD.NAME: closemode
FIELD.COMMENT: How close dates are set: days, session, date or none

FIELD.NAME: closedays
FIELD.COMMENT: Days from the open date to the close date in days mode

FIELD.NAME: closedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the common close date in date mode

FIELD.NAME: duemode
FIELD.COMMENT: How due dates are set: days, session, date or none

FIELD.NAME: duedays
FIELD.COMMENT: Days from the open date to the due date in days mode

FIELD.NAME: duedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the common due date in date mode

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of last modification

TABLE.NAME: tool_activitydates_cmids
TABLE.COMMENT: Course module IDs selected for activity dates scheduling

FIELD.NAME: activitydates
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to tool_activitydates configuration

FIELD.NAME: coursemoduleid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the selected course module

TABLE.NAME: tool_activitydates_lock
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the grade lock scheduling configuration per course

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this configuration applies to

FIELD.NAME: modtype
FIELD.COMMENT: The module or activity type last scheduled

FIELD.NAME: schedulestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the first session starts

FIELD.NAME: sessionlength
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of days per session

FIELD.NAME: activitiespersession
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of activities to lock together per session

FIELD.NAME: shownote
FIELD.COMMENT: Default value for showing the student-facing lock note on new selections

FIELD.NAME: shownotecoursepage
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether switched-on lock notes are also shown on the course page

FIELD.NAME: resetunselected
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether unselected activities of this modtype have their lock time cleared

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of last modification

TABLE.NAME: tool_activitydates_lockitem
TABLE.COMMENT: Course modules selected for grade lock scheduling

FIELD.NAME: lockid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to tool_activitydates_lock configuration

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the selected course module

FIELD.NAME: shownote
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to show the student-facing lock note on this activity

INDEX.NAME: cmid
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup of scheduling info by course module
